0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Kipeshpe is in need of a traveler with a little time to spare.

24.original: Deliver the freshly cut nopales and tuna to Nikawtenhe.

25.original: Deliver the freshly cut nopales and tuna to Tsanaya.

48.original: Can't say I've seen you here before. A traveler passing through, I take it? Before you set off, would you be willing to lend me a hand?

49.original: It's a simple thing, really. Just a small delivery of nopales and tuna.

50.original: Take these to Nikawtenhe at the saloon and Tsanaya by the rroneek stables. When you're finished, come back here, and I'll see if I can't put together a little something for your troubles.

51.original: You won't have to go far─just to the saloon and the rroneek stables. I promise to make it worth your time.

52.original: Welcome, friend. If you're looking to wet your whistle, I've got just the thing.

53.original: Why, this is the nopales and tuna I ordered! I certainly wasn't expecting you to be the one to deliver it.

54.original: If you've never tried them, I highly recommend it. Removing the needles can be something of a hassle, but nopales can be used for all sorts of cooking.

55.original: And the tuna can be used for desserts if you peel them, or squeezed to make juice.

56.original: Thank you for the quick delivery.

58.original: For me? From the nopales farmer? His timing is impeccable as always.

59.original: Water-laden as they are, nopales and tuna can be lifesavers when you're traveling about the wilds.

60.original: Lucky for me, they make great feed for the rroneek, as well. My thanks for the delivery, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>.

61.original: My thanks again to the farmer. There really is nothing more refreshing than fresh nopales and tuna.

62.original: You'll not want for water on your travels with nopales in your satchel.

63.original: Your empty hands tell me you've finished making the deliveries.

64.original: And what did you think, seeing their elation for a delivery of fresh nopales? Pique your interest? Or maybe even worked up your appetite?

65.original: You'll rarely find it eaten anywhere outside of the wilds, but someday, I hope to share the joys of nopales cuisine with all of Tural─no, the world!

66.original: A far-fetched dream, perhaps, but so long as travelers like yourself happen to be passing through, that's one more person I can reach.

67.original: The next time your stomach growls with hunger, I hope you'll consider answering with fresh nopales.
